about_short_description.short_description: Consul is a API ,multiple components and discovering and configuring services in your IT network infrastructure.

product.name: Consul Service Discovery
product.description: A system that tracks and registers services, their locations, and health statuses in real time using DNS or HTTP APIs.

product.name: Consul Service Mesh
product.description: A multi-platform service mesh that connects, configures, and secures services across various runtimes including Kubernetes, Nomad, and VMs.

product.name: Consul on Kubernetes
product.description: A service mesh solution tailored for Kubernetes environments to discover and securely connect applications using native Kubernetes tools.

product.name: Consul API Gateway
product.description: An integrated API gateway that manages and secures inbound and service-to-service traffic within the Consul service mesh.

product.name: Consul-Terraform-Sync
product.description: A tool that automates network infrastructure tasks by synchronizing changes in service topology with Terraform configurations.

product.name: Consul Observability
product.description: A system that collects and visualizes service mesh topology and performance metrics through a built-in UI and integrations with monitoring tools.
